kenex-310b3.description: Compact, easily manoeuvrable mobile radiation shield for confined areas directly at the examination table. Lower protective panel and weight-balanced lead-acrylic window that can be height-adjusted quickly and almost effortlessly. Optionally with side protective panels.
specs: Side protective panels (317/05-01), 0.5 mm Pb, +68 cm per panel (max. 214 cm)

kenex-326-05.description: Mobile radiation shield combining the properties of ceiling- and table-mounted systems: a weight-balanced lead-acrylic window is positioned over the patient and is height-adjustable. Flexible, width-adjustable curtains create a generous protection zone for the operator and assisting staff.

kenex-314-05.description: Compact, height-adjustable mobile shield for targeted shielding of patient or operator. A telescopic column with spring assistance carries a flexible protective panel; simple height adjustment.

kenex-303b2.description: Mobile radiation protection screen of solid-panel construction with a lead core, laminated on both sides with high-pressure plastic laminate and fitted with a lead-glass window. Robust, lockable castors and handles for easy mobility.

Lockable castors with brake, ABS edge protection, handles

kenex-303b3.description: Mobile radiation protection screen like the 303/B2/90, but with a wide panoramic lead-glass window for extended visibility. Solid-panel construction with a lead core, high-pressure laminate on both sides, lockable castors and handles.
